proof_body:
by
  intro a b m n g c x₀ y₀ x y hg hg0 ha hb h0
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ : ∃ u v : ℤ, g = a * u + b * v :=
    ⟨Int.gcdA a b, Int.gcdB a b, by rw [hg]; exact Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab a b⟩
  subst ha hb
  have h1 : m * u + n * v = 1 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hg0
    linear_combination -huv
  constructor
  · intro h3
    have h2 : m * (x - x₀) = n * (y₀ - y) := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hg0
      linear_combination h3 - h0
    refine ⟨u * (y₀ - y) + v * (x - x₀), ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination (-(x - x₀)) * h1 + u * h2
    · linear_combination (y₀ - y) * h1 + v * h2
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩
    linear_combination h0
target_source: ∀ (a b m n g c x₀ y₀ x y : ℤ), g = (Int.gcd a b : ℤ) → g ≠ 0 → a = g * m → b = g * n → a * x₀ + b * y₀ = c → (a * x + b * y = c ↔ ∃ t : ℤ, x = x₀ + n * t ∧ y = y₀ - m * t)
